name.en-US: The Love of Jesus to Penitents
name.pt-BR: O Amor de Jesus pelos Penitentes

description.en-US: Manning's book of 1862 on the Sacrament of Penance, written in Rome and dedicated to Fr. Coffin, Redemptorist: the sacrament as the special sacrament of the compassion of Jesus, as a means of self-knowledge, and the dispositions, the examination and the fruits of a good confession.
description.pt-BR: O livro de Manning (1862) sobre o sacramento da Penitência, escrito em Roma e dedicado ao Pe. Coffin, redentorista: o sacramento como o sacramento especial da compaixão de Jesus, como meio de autoconhecimento, e as disposições, o exame e os frutos de uma boa confissão.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Lambert, 1862; this printing 1872)

sources.edition: The Love of Jesus to Penitents (London: Burns, Oates, 1872 printing of the 1862 edition), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The dedicatory letter and the five chapters; the contents and the advertisements are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1872, so the text is public domain.
